title: Hundreds of scientists across the globe declare 'climate health emergency'
paragraphs: A new Lancet report has found the number of heat-related deaths has been growing since the 2015 Paris Agreement, despite real gains from the climate pact.
It says climate action is not keeping pace with increasing health impacts as the world keeps burning fossil fuels.
Researchers are calling for climate change to be declared a global health emergency to enable a coordinated global response.
